mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_command(tenant_id,actor_id,operation,command_key,request_hash) VALUES(#{key.tenantId},#{key.actorId},#{key.operation},#{key.commandKey},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE command_key=command_key
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,response_json FROM platform_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation=#{operation} AND command_key=#{commandKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_command SET response_json=#{response} WHERE tenant_id=#{key.tenantId} AND actor_id=#{key.actorId} AND operation=#{key.operation} AND command_key=#{key.commandKey} AND response_json IS NULL
